test_grpc_python_plugin: test the gRPC Python protoc plugin by running unittest on all RPC call types including unary, streaming, and duplex
run_servicer_methods: run the _ServicerMethods class to handle unary, streaming output, streaming input, full duplex, and half duplex RPC calls
create_grpc_service: create a live gRPC service with _CreateService that provides a servicer backend, server, and stub for testing RPCs
test_simple_stubs: test the simple stubs API via SimpleStubsPluginTest to invoke unary, streaming, and duplex calls without explicit stub instantiation
review_servicer_control: review the _ServicerMethods pause and fail context managers that control RPC execution flow for testing timeouts and cancellations
